story: Durvasa, a sage said to be born of Shiva's anger, was famous for his temper and his curses. He cursed Shakuntala to be forgotten by her husband, and his curse on Indra made the gods lose their power, which led to the churning of the ocean.
belief: He is respected as a powerful sage whose visits were both feared and welcomed, because he gave great boons to those who served him well. He gave Kunti the mantra to call the gods.
turns: He cursed people for small acts of disrespect, far out of proportion. Krishna once had to rescue the Pandavas from his anger when they had no food to offer him in the forest.
facts: His name means 'difficult to live with'.
Kunti's mantra, and so the births of Karna and the Pandavas, came from him.
He is said to be a partial incarnation of Shiva.
lessons: One careless moment can have long effects.
more: He was the son of the sage Atri and Anasuya.
When he cursed the devoted King Ambarisha, Vishnu's discus chased him until he begged the king's forgiveness.
